| Category = Sandwich recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breasts
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] mesquite wood chips, soaked in water 30 minutes
* Mesquite seasoning
* [[Cookbook:Olive oil|Olive oil]]
* 4 ciabatta rolls, split in half and [[Cookbook:Toasting|toasted]]
* [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|BBQ sauce]]
* 4 slices [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack]] cheese

== Procedure ==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] and toss chips onto coals. 
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] chicken with oil and season liberally with seasoning. [[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]], turning often, until internal temperature reaches {{#invoke:temperature|f|165}}
#Remove to a plate and cover tightly with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Add a slice of cheese to each one and let rest 5 minutes.
#Brush both sides with sauce. Place 1 breast inside each bun and serve immediately.
